brief:
Jerusalem Electricity's basketball team claimed first place in the championship, according to Maan Wire. The victory comes as the club continues to build its presence in Palestinian sports competition. The team's success in the tournament reflects the growing competitive level within the league.

The championship win adds to Jerusalem Electricity's athletic achievements across multiple sports programs. The club has invested in developing its roster and training infrastructure in recent seasons. Basketball competition in Palestine has expanded significantly, with teams across the country participating in organized league play.
title: Jerusalem Electricity wins basketball championship
